text:
Syed Ali Shah Geelani replaced Mirwaiz Maulvi Umar Farooq as APHC chairman in 1998. Wikipedia's infobox on [Syed Ali Shah Geelani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syed_Ali_Shah_Geelani) lists his term as 1998 to 20 July 2000, with Umar Farooq as predecessor. The team note saying the handover came after the 2002 elections is wrong: a search snippet shows Umar Farooq was still chairman during the 2002 dispute, and the split followed his failure to act on the Assembly-election issue.

CONFIDENCE: 75
